title: C¹ radial cutoffs whose integrals converge to the mass of the open ball
statement: There is a sequence of functions η_j : ℝ → ℝ (j ∈ ℕ) such that every η_j is C¹, η_j ≥ 0, deriv η_j ≤ 0 everywhere, and η_j(u) = 0 for u ≥ 1, and such that for every P ∈ ℕ, every measure μ on ℝ^P, every z ∈ ℝ^P and every s > 0 with μ(B_s(z)) < ∞ (open ball): ∫ η_j(|x − z|²/s²) dμ(x) → μ(B_s(z)) (as a real number, μ.real (ball z s)) as j → ∞.
lean_statement: ∃ η : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 1 (η j)) ∧ (∀ j u, 0 ≤ η j u) ∧ (∀ j u, deriv (η j) u ≤ 0) ∧ (∀ j u, 1 ≤ u → η j u = 0) ∧ ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (z : Euclid P) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → μ (ball z s) < ∞ → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, η j (‖x - z‖ ^ 2 / s ^ 2) ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (μ.real (ball z s)))
